digest.component_or_area: event authorship tracking and fsck auditing
propositions: When a signing_key is configured but author_id is unresolvable and require_authenticated is off, _apply_authorship returns silently without logging or failing the write, masking unsigned writes
fsck authorship tally is aggregated store-wide into a single uncounted advisory line, making per-env unsigned-write patterns invisible

AC2: fsck must count and report (not advise) any env_id with zero signed events or all Unknown-authored events that wrote at or after the store's first signed event, gating out dormant pre-signing envs
AC3: _apply_authorship must emit logger.warning when signing is skipped due to missing author_id or signing_key, naming the event uuid and ticket, while remaining best-effort (no write failure)
The mechanism was confirmed in code review and the measurement disproven the creation_channel=null limb, leaving only AC2 and AC3 in scope per operator decision
